title: Test plan · Week 2 · v1
sub: 3 tests, $77 test budget for the week
headline: Week 2 clears the overdue Test 1 readout at $2.31 vs $4.00 (0.578x) with 87 results and rebuilds momentum with fresh creative in both active campaigns while testing a low-pressure new angle.

content.summary: Week 2 clears the overdue Test 1 readout at $2.31 vs $4.00 (0.578x) with 87 results and rebuilds momentum with fresh creative in both active campaigns while testing a low-pressure new angle.

tests.name: Testimonial Scale Extension - Tiny-Space Phone
tests.hypothesis: If we keep the winning testimonial angle but emphasize tiny-space no-gear workouts, cost per result will stay under $4.00 like Test 1 at $2.31.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost per result > $4.00 after 30 results or $60 spend; scale if <= $3.40 after 30 results.

brief.hook: Ten minutes, no gear, in your living room
brief.key_message: Phone shows Beans' Active 10-minute no-equipment routine for a tiny living room.

tests.name: Busy-Day Progress Refresh - Phone
tests.hypothesis: A fits-a-busy-day message on the phone will keep Progress/Streak v2 efficiency under $4.00.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost per result > $4.00 after $60 spend; keep if <= $4.00.

brief.hook: A short plan that fits between meetings
brief.key_message: Phone shows Beans' Active plan that fits a busy day in a small space.

tests.name: Low-Pressure Quiz Start Exploratory - Phone
tests.hypothesis: A low-pressure quiz and free trial message will find trial starts at target cost from people not responding to performance angles.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost per result > $4.00 after $60 spend; keep learning if <= $4.00.

brief.key_message: Phone shows quick quiz on Beans' Active to get a personalized plan and start free trial.
